summary: Limitation for Section 34 application; 3 months excludes date of award receipt per Section 12(1), Limitation Act; period expires on court holiday (09.07.2022); Section 4 applicable; filing on next working day valid; condonation not required; deposit conditions upheld at 50%; precedent from Himachal Techno Engineers and My Preferred Transformation affirmed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment upholding limitation and allowing Section 34 application upheld; respondent's application held within time; deposit conditions sustained.
